hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for NFTX collection pools, pairing NFT collection tokens against a native token. Implements dynamic LP fees with per-address flat-fee exemptions, an optional AMM fee taken from the unspecified swap leg, pending-donation queuing for LP fee distribution, and a truncated-tick oracle; pool creation and lifecycle are restricted to the NFTX Locker contract.
